reviews.quote: The book is pacey and pithy and cogently argued.

awards: Winner, inaugural Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize, 2018
notes: First English edition: Yale University Press, 2017 (South Asia edition by HarperCollins India, ISBN 9789352643127). One verbatim review quote confirmed from a fetched page (South Asia Journal). NIF Book Prize win verified via search.

reviews.quote: the book gently immerses you in the landscapes of Kathiawar, the warmth of Gandhi's home

notes: English translation by Hemang Ashwinkumar, published by Penguin/Viking, 2025 (ISBN-13 9780143475873; Amazon.in ISBN-10 0143475878). Original Gujarati 'Jeevan nu Parodh' (1948) won the Narmad Suvarna Chandrak, but that was for the original, not this English edition. Only one confirmable verbatim review quote found (Storizen); Scroll.in carried only an excerpt.

reviews.quote: The title of the volume, Believer's Dilemma, is quite apt.
Choudhary's two volumes on Vajpayee expose us to realities buried in the whisper corridors of Delhi.

notes: Second volume of a two-part Vajpayee biography; published by Picador India (Pan Macmillan India), 20 July 2025. Metadata verified via the Pan Macmillan publisher page. Two press reviews fetched and quoted verbatim (The Asian Age, India's World). Several preferred outlets (Business Standard, Deccan Herald, Frontline, Scroll) blocked WebFetch.

reviews.quote: The unusual title of the book hides a fascinating 'tour de force' of about 500 years of the cultural history of Karnataka

notes: Published by Context (an imprint of Westland Books), 2025; ISBN-13 verified via Google Books and Waterstones. One press review fetched and quoted verbatim (Star of Mysore). A Frontline review and a NewsClick review exist but those sites returned fetch errors. The Federal and Scroll pieces are author interviews, not reviews.

reviews.quote: The beauty of Dixit's book is that it keeps the readers enthralled, despite telling us what we most likely already know.
Neha's writing is lucid. Her writing holds attention and engages.

awards: Shortlisted, 2025 Moore Prize for Human Rights Writing
notes: Publisher (Juggernaut), 2024 first edition, and ISBN-13 confirmed via retailer listings; Amazon and Scroll/Mint pages blocked WebFetch. Two verbatim reviews from fetched pages (The Federal, The AIDEM). Moore Prize shortlisting confirmed via search.

reviews.quote: The examination of what it truly means to be a woman runner is quite an eye-opener
Through the intimate accounts of eight women athletes, Sohini Chattopadhyay's The Day I Became a Runner leaves you feeling educated, inspired, and agitated.

notes: Publisher (HarperCollins India, 2023) and ISBN-13 confirmed via HarperCollins product page and retailer listings. Scroll.in and Mint review pages blocked WebFetch; two verbatim reviews extracted from fetched pages (The Federal, Kunzum). No awards verified.
First English edition published as Allen Lane hardcover (Penguin Random House India), 2023. Two reviews verified from fetched pages; no prizes could be verified.
